name: io.github.Turbo-Crowd/openproject-mcp
title: OpenProject MCP
description: General-purpose OpenProject API v3 MCP server with native OpenProject authorization by default.

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds from 1000 to 300000

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: API-token authentication mode: basic or bearer

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Platform-separated upload roots; affects only uploads

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Restricted mode: enable explicitly scoped writes

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Restricted mode: comma-separated permitted project IDs

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_ALLOWED_WORK_PACKAGE_TYPE_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Restricted mode: comma-separated permitted type IDs
